pages.text: Northwind Protect Term Plan. Policyholder: Sample Customer. Sum assured: 5,000,000. Policy term: 20 years. Premium paying term: 20 years. This is a synthetic sample document bundled with docket to demonstrate long-document question answering; it contains no real personal data.

Premium schedule. Annual premium: 14,400 payable each year. Semi-annual premium: 7,344 payable twice a year. Monthly premium: 1,260 payable every month. The monthly mode carries a 5 percent modal loading versus the annual mode. Total premium payable over the full 20 year term under the monthly mode is 302,400.

Charges and benefits. Goods and services tax of 18 percent applies to the first year premium and 18 percent on renewal premiums for the risk portion. Death benefit equals the sum assured of 5,000,000. There is no maturity benefit under this pure term plan. Grace period for monthly mode is 15 days and for annual mode is 30 days.
